messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liao <samantha@latticeworks.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: staggered PO release + SKU normalization

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Per our checklist I attached the completed onboarding form and a first-pass SKU mapping (sku_mapping.csv). A couple of things we need to align on before we can push a PO into the issuance queue:

- Spend cap requested: LatticeWorks listed $150,000 annual. Can you confirm whether that is a single-account cap or split across two legal entities?
- Line item cleanup: the CSV has three SKUs that map to the same internal ledger item (LW-API, LW-API-ENTERPRISE, LW-API-ADDON). We prefer a single consolidated SKU on the PO and then indicate addons as sub-lines. Can you confirm which SKU you want canonicalized?
- PO issuance rhythm: we have a throttled PO queue for new vendors to reduce provisioning errors. If LatticeWorks prefers immediate full issuance (one PO covering the full cap) we need an explicit procurement signoff and DOCS completed (DocuSign attached). Otherwise we can issue provisional POs in tranches (recommended) and then merge lines into a final PO after 30 days of billing stability.

Next steps I suggest: you confirm canonical SKU, confirm legal entity for cap assignment, and sign the DocuSign. I’ll loop Karthik for PO issuance once we have that.

Attachments: lattice_onboarding_form.pdf (onboarding form), sku_mapping.csv (proposed mapping), docusign_vendor_agreement.pdf (vendor agreement)

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
From: Samantha Liao <samantha@latticeworks.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@latticeworks.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 14:10:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: staggered PO release + SKU normalization

Thanks Aditya —

Quick answers: we confirm the $150k cap applies to a single contracting entity (LatticeWorks, Inc.). Canonical SKU should be LW-API (please use that on the PO); the other two are billing aliases we can collapse. Procurement will sign the DocuSign by EOD tomorrow.

A couple of clarifications from our side: our legal team wants the PO to show explicit line items for base API and support (two lines) — is that compatible with your consolidation suggestion? Also, we usually request the full PO because many of our downstream vendors require it for onboarding. If you can do an initial provisional PO to unblock vendor setups, great — but we will still need a path to convert to a single issued PO later.

Samantha Liao
Head of Partnerships, LatticeWorks
samantha@latticeworks.com

Karthik / Marissa —

Forwarding Samantha’s confirmation. She confirmed single contracting entity and wants PO to show two explicit lines (base API + support). They also asked for the ability to convert provisional tranche POs into a single final PO later.

Can we: 
1) Issue a provisional PO sequence (PROV-RD-5631-01) for $50k today to unblock initial provisioning, with two lines (LW-API base — $45k, LW-SUPPORT — $5k);
2) Reserve the remaining $100k on the spendcap but leave it as a pending allocation so we can issue subsequent provisional POs quickly;
3) Provide a migration path to collapse tranches into RD-5631-FINAL after 30 days if billing is stable (and update ledger to use LW-API canonical SKU).

If there are any compliance flags from procurement (billing code, tax id verification) — please flag here. Samantha: expect DocuSign today, but Karthik will confirm once a provisional PO is in the queue.

Thanks,
Aditya
